title: Parse Error
summary: Generic fallback — the parser cannot understand the input

title: Expected Token
summary: A required token (usually :) is missing at this position

title: Unexpected Token
summary: A token appeared in a position where the grammar forbids it

title: Reserved Identifier
summary: A user-defined name collides with a word reserved by Kain, HLSL, C++, or host runtime

title: Missing Delimiter Before Newline
summary: Block header missing : before the body — the most common parse error

title: Expected Contextual Keyword
summary: A contextual keyword (patch, law, axiom, pulse, etc.) was expected but not found

title: Unclosed Delimiter
summary: A bracket, brace, or parenthesis was opened but never closed

title: Mismatched Delimiter
summary: A closing delimiter did not match its opening counterpart

title: Invalid Numeric Literal
summary: A numeric literal could not be parsed (malformed hex, binary, octal, float)

title: Invalid String Literal
summary: A string literal is malformed or unescaped

title: Invalid Character Literal
summary: A character literal contains more than one codepoint

title: Attribute Syntax Error
summary: @name or @name(args...) attribute syntax is malformed

title: Effect Annotation Syntax Error
summary: Effect annotation (Pure, IO, Async, GPU, Reactive, Unsafe) in an invalid position

title: Module Declaration Error
summary: mod declaration is incomplete (missing name or body/path)

title: Use/Import Syntax Error
summary: use import path is malformed (e.g., double ::)

title: Visibility Modifier Error
summary: pub stands alone without an attached declaration

title: Comptime Block Syntax Error
summary: comptime block body could not be parsed

title: Macro Invocation Syntax Error
summary: macro definition or invocation is malformed

title: Test Declaration Syntax Error
summary: test block declaration is malformed

title: Trait path before for expected (impl)
summary: Expected trait path before 'for' in impl block, found non-path type

title: Only fn allowed in impl blocks
summary: Expected 'fn' in impl block (impl blocks can only contain function definitions)

title: Invalid C include target
summary: Expected C include target such as nuklear, native/nuklear, "../native/nuklear.h", or <vulkan/vulkan.h>

title: Bare include with version rejected
summary: bare include form does not accept a version; use angle brackets: include <foo.h> 1.0 as bar

title: Unknown macro param kind
summary: Unknown macro param kind (must be expr, type, ident, block, or token)

title: Duplicate axiom fallback
summary: axiom blocks may only declare one fallback

title: Invalid axiom keyword
summary: axiom blocks expect 'when', 'guarantee', or 'fallback'

title: Unknown axiom predicate
summary: Unknown axiom predicate; expected target(...), arch(...), or capability(...)

title: Duplicate converge spec lane
summary: converge blocks may only declare one spec lane

title: Invalid converge keyword
summary: Expected 'spec', 'fast', or 'verify' inside converge block

title: Converge requires spec lane
summary: converge blocks require exactly one spec lane

title: Converge requires fast lane
summary: converge blocks require at least one fast lane

title: Missing state after weak in component
summary: Expected 'state' keyword after 'weak' in component (use 'weak state name: Type = value')
example_good: component Foo: weak state x: i32 = 0

title: Unexpected identifier in component body
summary: Unexpected identifier in component. Valid keywords: state, weak, pulse, resonate, render, or fn

title: Unexpected token in component
summary: Unexpected token in component. Expected state, weak, pulse, resonate, render, fn, or JSX element

title: Component missing render body
summary: Component must have a render body (JSX element)

title: Invalid shader stage
summary: Expected one of: vertex, fragment, compute, surface, mesh, task, raygen, anyhit, closesthit, miss, intersection, callable

title: Expected shader stage
summary: Expected a shader stage

title: Invalid uniform binding
summary: Expected integer binding after '@' (e.g., @0, @1, @2)

title: Unexpected identifier in actor
summary: Unexpected identifier in actor. Valid keywords: state, var, fn, or on

title: Invalid token in actor
summary: Expected 'state', 'var', 'fn', or 'on' in actor definition

title: Unknown orchestrate stage kind
summary: Unknown orchestrate stage kind; expected kain, c, cpu, gpu, dispatch, converge, law, patch, world, python, rust, or node

title: Unknown orchestrate residency
summary: Unknown orchestrate residency; expected host, shared, or device

title: Unknown orchestrate transfer
summary: Unknown orchestrate transfer; expected none, host_to_device, device_to_host, or shared_view

title: Unknown orchestrate policy
summary: Unknown orchestrate policy; expected static, telemetry_prefer_gpu, telemetry_prefer_cpu, or telemetry_balance_latency

title: Struct literal syntax rejected
summary: Struct literal syntax is not supported in KAIN. Use field-by-field assignment instead

title: Unclosed brace in f-string
summary: Unclosed '{' in f-string

title: Spawn requires named arguments
summary: Spawn requires named arguments

title: Send requires named arguments
summary: Send requires named arguments

title: Expected message call after send
summary: Expected message call after send

title: Unknown scoped ownership keyword
summary: Unknown scoped ownership keyword

title: No ++ or -- in Kain
summary: ++ and -- are not valid operators in Kain. Use x += 1 or x -= 1

title: Expected attribute value
summary: Expected attribute value

title: JSX element name must be uppercase
summary: JSX element name must start with an uppercase letter

title: Expected closing tag
summary: Expected closing tag for <Name>

title: Expected JSX tag name
summary: Expected JSX tag name

title: Expected = in JSX attribute
summary: Expected '=' in JSX attribute

title: Top-level item expected
summary: Expected item (fn, patch, law, axiom, converge, world, entangle, ...)

title: Defer missing expression
summary: defer expects an expression payload in v1

title: World missing surface (parse-level)
summary: world block must contain at least one surface projection

title: Entangle missing from/to
summary: entangle requires both 'from' and 'to' target components

title: Invalid entangle endpoint
summary: Entangle endpoint must be a dotted path like World.component.field

title: Invalid resonate endpoint
summary: Resonate endpoint must be a dotted path like World.component.field

title: Duplicate struct update ..base
summary: Struct update syntax only supports one '..base' expression

title: Empty struct update ..
summary: Struct update syntax requires an expression after '..'

title: Expected if after else
summary: Expected if expression after else

title: Expected delegate keyword
summary: Expected 'delegate' keyword

title: Unexpected method in state definition
summary: Unexpected method in state definition. Use @transition for transitions.

title: Animation property not a string
summary: Expected string literal for animation property

title: Expected identifier
summary: Expected identifier

title: Unexpected end of input
summary: Unexpected end of input
